findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_booking, confirm_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, get_hotel_details, get_payment_url, guest_login · Private data: prepare_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, create_checkout, guest_login, get_statement_document · Public sink: prepare_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, get_payment_url, create_checkout, guest_login · Destructive: get_hotel_rooms, prepare_booking, get_statement_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_booking, confirm_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, get_hotel_details, get_payment_url, guest_login · Private data: prepare_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, create_checkout, guest_login, get_statement_document · Public sink: prepare_booking, list_bookings, get_booking_details, cancel_booking, get_payment_url, create_checkout, guest_login · Destructive: get_hotel_rooms, prepare_booking, get_statement_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
